quests.title: Where's Nub?

steps.objText: Look for small tracks by the stone
steps.journal: Burl's cub Nub has wandered off again. Look for small tracks by the stone.

steps.objText: Follow the tracks to the tower door
steps.journal: Small tracks lead away from the stone. Follow them to the tower door.

steps.objText: Follow the wet prints down the road
steps.journal: No Nub at the door, only wet prints. Follow them down the road.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl where the tracks went

offer: Have you seen my Nub? Small. Round. Never listens.
He was by the waystone at sunup. Then he wasn't.
Take this. A hunter left it on my slope, long ago.
A bow sees further than a bear. Find his tracks.
active: Small tracks, sky-cub. Smaller than mine. Follow them.
ready: Down the road west? All that way, on those legs.
...Smell that? Wet cub. He came home behind you.
He followed your tracks while you followed his.
For your trouble. It was in his mouth. Still warm.
done: Nub sleeps. Sleeps! First time in three days.

quests.title: The North Boars

steps.objText: Drive off the three north boars
steps.journal: More boars dig in the north woods. Burl wants three of them driven off.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl the north is quiet

offer: More boars, sky-cub. Three, up by the north trees.
They smelled the empty slope and came back for it.
active: Three. North trees. Listen for the chewing.
ready: Quiet up north. I can hear the bees again.
Here. Red, and bitter. It mends what tusks tear.
done: North is quiet. West, though. Hear that?

quests.title: The West Boars

steps.objText: Drive off the two west boars
steps.journal: Two boars root on the west side. Drive them off for Burl.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl the west is quiet

offer: Two more, down the west side. Young ones, loud.
Young is not slow. Mind your feet.
active: Two, west side. Loud. You won't miss them.
ready: West is quiet. Only two, and so much noise.
Sticks with feathers. Hunters lose them everywhere.
done: West is quiet. The south slope still grunts.

quests.title: The South Boars

steps.objText: Drive off the three south boars
steps.journal: The south woods have boars again. Drive off all three for Burl.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl the south is quiet

offer: Last of them. Three, on the south slope, by the rocks.
The big one leads. Don't let him get behind you.
active: South slope, by the rocks. Mind the big one.
ready: All of them! The whole slope is mine again.
A walker left this by the rocks. It fits you better.
done: No boars. Just bees, and berries, and a sky-cub.

steps.objText: Bring Burl a piece of boar meat
steps.journal: Winter is coming and Burl's den is bare. Bring her a piece of boar meat.

offer: Berries are summer food. Winter wants fat.
Those boars owe me. Bring me a haunch, sky-cub.
active: A haunch. Boar. You know where they grunt.
ready: Mm. Still warm. The boars pay their rent at last.
Trade you. It's bitter, but it mends.
done: One haunch. Winter is long, sky-cub. But it's a start.

steps.objText: Go and look at the waystone
steps.journal: Burl worries about the waystone. Go and see that it still glows.

offer: The stone by the meadow hums at night now.
I don't go near it. Old habit. Go see it for me?
active: The stone. Put your paw on it. Your hand. Whichever.
ready: Warm, and humming. Like a hive in the ground.
I'll sleep near it, then. Here. Feathered sticks.
done: The stone hums. I hum back. Nobody minds.

quests.title: The Hill Path

steps.objText: Walk the hill path below the tower
steps.journal: Burl knows a path along the hill below the tower. Walk it.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl the hill path is clear

offer: The path down from your tower. The boars dug at it.
Walk it for me. Tell me if it still holds a foot.
active: The hill path, under your tower. Walk it.
ready: Holds, does it? Good. Old legs like a sure path.
A red one. For the bruises you didn't tell me about.
done: Path holds, stone hums. Good hill, this.

steps.objText: Look at the tower door
steps.journal: Burl does not trust the tower. Go back and look at its door.

offer: You came out of the tower by its old door.
Something scratches at it at night. Go and look?
active: The tower door. Look low down, for the scratches.
ready: Claw marks, low down? Badgers. Rude, but not boars.
Feathered sticks. You use them better than I do.
done: Badgers at the door. You could do worse for neighbours.

steps.objText: Walk down to the river bank
steps.journal: Burl wants to know if the river is safe. Walk down to the bank.

steps.objText: Find the stones at the ford
steps.journal: The bank is quiet. Find the stones where the river can be crossed.

offer: West, past the bend, there's a river. Loud water.
I haven't seen it since I was a cub. Is it still there?
active: The river. West. You'll hear it before you see it.
ready: Still there. Still loud. Good. Some things should stay.
Someone left this on my slope once. It fits a walker.
done: Loud water, stones to cross. Don't fall in, sky-cub.

quests.title: Word from the Crossroads

steps.objText: Read the note post at the crossroads
steps.journal: Burl asks what the crossroads post says. Go and read it.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl what the post says

offer: Birds say there's a post at the crossroads. With paper.
I can't read, sky-cub. Go and read it for me?
active: The post at the crossroads. Read it, then tell me.
ready: Straw men, and arrows? Someone out there practises.
Practising means staying. Here, sky-cub. A red one.
done: Someone at the crossroads. I hope they like berries.

quests.title: Walk Burl to the Bend

steps.objText: Walk with Burl to the Bend Waystone
steps.journal: Burl wants to see the Bend Waystone blink. Walk with her to it.

quests.returnText: Talk to Burl at the Bend Waystone

offer: The bend stone blinks now, you say. I want to see it.
Old legs. Walk slow with me?
active: Slow, sky-cub. Bears don't hurry. Bears arrive.
ready: There. Blink, blink, blink. Like it's calling someone.
Thank you for the slow walk. Sticks, for your bow.
done: I'll sit here a while. Then the long way home.

quests.title: Meat for the Basket

steps.objText: Leave the meat in the post basket
steps.journal: Burl gave you two pieces of meat. Leave them in the post basket.

quests.returnText: Put the meat in the trade post basket

offer: There's a basket on a post, by the crossroads.
Whoever fills it feeds whoever comes. Take this meat.
Two haunches. I have more than one bear needs.
active: Two haunches, in the basket. Don't eat them on the way.
ready: You lay the meat in the basket, under the tag:
TAKEN. LEAVE WHAT YOU CAN SPARE.
Beneath it, a bundle of arrows. Twine. Fresh knots.
done: Fed someone, did we? Good. The slope can spare it.

quests.title: Leave What You Can Spare

steps.objText: Carry three arrows to the note post
steps.journal: The post asks travellers to leave what they can. Carry three arrows to it.

quests.returnText: Leave the arrows at the note post

offer: A second tag, tied under the first:
THREE ARROWS TO THE NOTE POST. FOR PRACTICE.
Three arrows lie beside it, set apart.
active: The tag sways: THREE ARROWS TO THE NOTE POST.
ready: A clip on the post. You leave the three arrows in it.
In the clip already: a red draught, stoppered.
done: The basket waits. The tags turn in the wind.

quests.title: Three Straw Men

objectives.journal: Three straw men stand by the note post. Hit the first with an arrow.
One straw man hit. Now put an arrow in the second.
Two down. One straw man still stands. Hit the third.

quests.returnText: Take the bundle from the note post

offer: Three straw men. Three arrows. Three hits.
The bundle under the post is for whoever can.
active: Three straw men. Three hits. The bundle waits.
ready: Three hits. Under the post, a bundle of arrows.
Twenty, tied with twine. Fresh knots.
done: A new line on the tally. Yours, this time.

quests.title: Left at the Bend

steps.objText: Wear the buckler to the ford
steps.journal: Someone left a buckler at the Bend Waystone. Wear it down to the ford.

quests.returnText: Show the buckler at the Ford Waystone

offer: TICK. TICK-TICK. A drawer slides out of the mount.
HELD: ONE BUCKLER. LEFT FOR THE NEXT WALKER.
NO NAME. CARRY IT WORN. SHOW THE FORD.
active: TICK. BUCKLER WORN? FORD. WEST.
ready: TICK. BUCKLER SEEN. CARRIER LOGGED.
KEEP IT. ONE DRAUGHT, HELD FOR YOU.
done: TICK. CARRIER LOGGED AT THE FORD. LINE HOLDS.

quests.title: Word for Burl

steps.objText: Carry the waystone's word to Burl
steps.journal: The waystone has word for Burl. Carry it back to her slope.

quests.returnText: Go back to the Bend Waystone

offer: TICK. BEAR ON THE SLOPE. KNOWN.
MESSAGE: ROAD CLEAR. LIGHT HOLDS. CARRY IT.
active: TICK. MESSAGE FOR THE BEAR. NOT YET CARRIED.
ready: TICK. MESSAGE CARRIED. LOGGED.
FIVE ARROWS, HELD FOR YOU.
done: TICK. LINE QUIET. ALL WELL.

steps.objText: Walk back along the road
steps.journal: Something on the road west needs a second look. Walk back along it.

steps.objText: Come back to the Bend Waystone
steps.journal: You walked the road. Now come back to the Bend Waystone.

offer: TICK. ROAD CHECK DUE. LAST CHECK: LONG AGO.
WALK TO THE OLD TURN. RETURN. REPORT.
active: TICK. ROAD CHECK OPEN. WALK. RETURN.
ready: TICK. ROAD CHECKED. LOGGED.
FIVE ARROWS, HELD FOR YOU.
done: TICK. NEXT ROAD CHECK: LONG FROM NOW.

steps.objText: Walk down to the river bank
steps.journal: Wet boots are the price of the far bank. Walk down to the river.

steps.objText: Cross to the west bank
steps.journal: You stand at the water's edge. Cross over to the west bank.

offer: TICK. FORD STONES: UNCHECKED.
CROSS. COUNT THE STONES. RETURN.
active: TICK. FORD UNCHECKED. CROSS. RETURN.
ready: TICK. FORD CROSSED. WALKER WET.
DRY BOOTS, HELD FOR YOU. TAKE THEM.
done: TICK. FORD CHECKED. MIND THE MOSS.

steps.objText: Climb to the lookout north of the ford
steps.journal: From the ford, a thread of smoke shows in the north. Climb the lookout.

offer: TICK. NORTH WATCH DUE. NO WATCHER.
CLIMB. LOOK NORTH. RETURN. REPORT.
active: TICK. NORTH WATCH OPEN. CLIMB. LOOK.
ready: TICK. NORTH WATCH DONE. LOGGED.
TEN ARROWS, HELD FOR YOU.
done: TICK. NORTH WATCH LOGGED. LINE HOLDS.

steps.objText: Walk the west road to the crossroads
steps.journal: The west road leads to a crossroads. Walk it and see what is there.

offer: TICK. CROSSROADS: NO REPORT IN YEARS.
WALK THERE. RETURN. REPORT.
active: TICK. CROSSROADS REPORT OPEN.
ready: TICK. CROSSROADS REPORTED. LOGGED.
ONE DRAUGHT, HELD FOR YOU.
done: TICK. ALL ROADS REPORTED. ALMOST.

steps.objText: Come back to the river bank
steps.journal: You have been across. Come back to the river bank.

offer: TICK. FORD CHECK, RETURN LEG. DUE.
CROSS BACK. RETURN. REPORT.
active: TICK. RETURN LEG OPEN. CROSS BACK.
ready: TICK. BOTH LEGS LOGGED. FORD SOUND.
TEN ARROWS, HELD FOR YOU.
done: TICK. FORD SOUND. WALKER SOUND. LINE HOLDS.

steps.objText: Look at the gap in the meadow fence
steps.journal: Something got through the meadow fence. Look at the gap for Burl.

offer: Someone opened the old gate on the meadow side.
Boars don't unlatch. Go and look, sky-cub.
active: The meadow fence. Where the posts lean. Go look.
ready: A gap and a leaning rail? Rot, not paws. Good.
Here. I found these in the roots. You use them.
done: Rot, not paws. I can sleep on that.

quests.title: The Woodcutter's Corner

steps.objText: Check the woodcutter's stack
steps.journal: Burl smelled something at the woodcutter's corner. Check the stack.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl the stack is dry

offer: There's a woodcutter's stack by my clearing.
Nobody cuts here. Who stacked it? Go and sniff.
active: The stack, north of my clearing. Look closely.
ready: Dry, and old. Left by a walker, then. Like you.
Trade you a red draught for the news.
done: An old stack, warm in the sun. I sit by it now.

steps.objText: Look at the cart by the road
steps.journal: An old cart sits by the road. Burl wants to know what is in it.

offer: I smell a cart on the road west. Wood, and old rope.
No horse. Go and tell me what it carried.
active: The cart, down the road west. Mind the crates.
ready: Empty and tipped. Whoever left it left in a hurry.
Feathered sticks. They were in the straw.
done: A tipped cart. Many left in a hurry, that year.

steps.objText: Walk along the lamps by the road
steps.journal: Old lamps line the verge of the road. Walk along them.

offer: TICK. LAMPS: TWO. LIT: UNKNOWN.
WALK THE VERGE. RETURN. REPORT.
active: TICK. LAMP COUNT OPEN. WALK THE VERGE.
ready: TICK. LAMPS COUNTED. TWO. BRASS.
ONE DRAUGHT, HELD FOR YOU.
done: TICK. TWO LAMPS. LINE HOLDS.

steps.objText: Check the rocks by the forest edge
steps.journal: Rocks pile up at the forest edge, too neat to be chance. Check them.

offer: TICK. ROAD NORTH VERGE: ROCKS. FALLEN LOGS.
CHECK. RETURN. REPORT.
active: TICK. VERGE CHECK OPEN. ROCKS. LOGS.
ready: TICK. VERGE CLEAR. LOGS OLD. LOGGED.
FIVE ARROWS, HELD FOR YOU.
done: TICK. VERGE LOGGED. LINE HOLDS.

quests.title: Brass for the Ford

steps.objText: Carry the brass to the Ford Waystone
steps.journal: You carry a brass scrap for the Ford Waystone. Bring it there.

quests.returnText: Set the brass at the Ford Waystone

offer: TICK. BRASS, ONE PIECE. HELD FOR THE FORD.
CARRY WEST. LEAVE AT THE FORD MOUNT.
active: TICK. BRASS IN TRANSIT. FORD. WEST.
ready: TICK. BRASS RECEIVED. FORD MOUNT SEATED.
TEN ARROWS, HELD FOR YOU.
done: TICK. BRASS DELIVERED. BEND WAYSTONE: NOTED.

steps.objText: Look at the wallow south of the road
steps.journal: Rook saw boars rolling in mud. Look at the wallow south of the road.

offer: Boars. At the wallow, south of the Bend road.
They dug up my hides. I counted. They are short.
Go and look. Tell me how many holes.
active: The wallow. South. Count the holes for me.
ready: Eleven holes, and one very fat boar. Ha.
Mine, the hides, but you may have this. Found it.
done: Eleven. I will never get them all back.

steps.objText: Look at the river farm gate
steps.journal: Burl remembers a farm by the river. Go and look at its gate.

offer: A farm by the river. I smelled bread there once.
Go and look at its gate. Tell me who lives there.
active: The farm gate, by the river. South of the road.
ready: Plates set for three. The gate chained from outside.
Oh, sky-cub. Here. Take this. Wear it well.
done: Three plates. I will not think about it. Much.

quests.title: Where the Bees Go

steps.objText: Follow the bees to the old bee farm
steps.journal: Bees drift past Burl's slope, heavy with pollen. Follow them home.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl where the bees go

offer: My bees fly south at noon and come back sticky.
Follow them, sky-cub. Walk. Don't swat.
active: South-east, past the meadow. Follow the hum.
ready: A bee farm! Old boxes, and honey still in them.
Good. I won't tell the crow. Take these.
done: The bees know a farm I don't. Fair enough.

steps.objText: Walk to the ring of standing stones
steps.journal: Burl speaks of a ring of standing stones. Walk out and find it.

offer: Past the bees, there is a ring of stones. Old ones.
Cut with the same letters as the humming stone.
Go and see. Take your paw, hand, whichever.
active: The ring of stones. Past the bee farm.
ready: Cut like the waystone. So it is a long road, this.
Two red draughts. Mind the hills on the way home.
done: The same letters. The same hum, I think.

quests.title: Boars in the Stores

steps.objText: Drive off the two boars at the post
steps.journal: Two boars broke into the stores at the post. Drive them off.

quests.returnText: Take what the post left for you

offer: A tag on the basket: BOARS BROKE THE CROCK.
TWO. SOUTH OF THE POST. DRIVE THEM OFF.
active: The tag: TWO BOARS, SOUTH OF THE POST.
ready: The grain crock is whole again. The boars are gone.
In the basket, new, tied with twine: a bundle.
done: The tag is turned over. It reads: THANK YOU.

steps.objText: Pick five red caps on tree trunks
steps.journal: Rook wants red caps, the ones that grow on tree trunks. Pick five.

offer: Red caps. Shelf fungus on trunks, up the road.
Five. I like red. A crow may like what it likes.
active: Five red caps. On the trunks. Up the road.
ready: Five. Not one eaten. You are better than a crow.
Take these. I made them. Yes, I did.
done: Red. Shiny. Mine. Thank you, fell-bird.

steps.objText: Look at the dry well north of the post
steps.journal: Rook heard something in the dry well north of the post. Look at it.

offer: There is a well. Dry. Planks on it. A brick fell.
I think the bottom has something in it. Look. I can't.
active: The well, north of the trade post. Planks and bricks.
ready: Dry, and no echo? Then it is full of leaves. Ha.
You looked. I counted. Here, five sticks.
done: A dry well. Even the rain gave up on it.

steps.objText: Look at the fallen shrine by the post
steps.journal: A shrine lies fallen by the note post. Go and look at it.

offer: A fresh scrap pinned on the post, in a careful hand:
THE SHRINE EAST OF HERE FELL. TELL ME WHICH WAY.
active: The note: THE SHRINE EAST FELL. WHICH WAY?
ready: You look. The pillar leans WEST, toward the water.
A new line on the note, and ten arrows tied below.
done: The note: WEST. THANK YOU. IT WAS ALWAYS WEST.

steps.objText: Walk out on the old jetty
steps.journal: An old jetty runs out over the water. Walk out on its planks, carefully.

offer: TICK. EAST BANK JETTY: PLANKS. CONDITION: ROT.
WALK OUT. RETURN. REPORT.
active: TICK. JETTY CHECK OPEN. PLANKS: ROT.
ready: TICK. JETTY HOLDS A WALKER. NOT TWO. LOGGED.
FIVE ARROWS, HELD FOR YOU.
done: TICK. JETTY LOGGED. ONE WALKER MAX.

quests.title: A Cog for the Bend

steps.objText: Carry the cog to the Bend Waystone
steps.journal: You carry a cog from the ford. Take it to the Bend Waystone.

quests.returnText: Set the cog at the Bend Waystone

offer: TICK. SPARE COG, ONE. HELD FOR THE BEND.
CARRY EAST. LEAVE AT THE BEND MOUNT.
active: TICK. COG IN TRANSIT. BEND. EAST.
ready: TICK. COG SEATED. BEND MOUNT QUIET. SOUND.
TEN ARROWS, HELD FOR YOU.
done: TICK. COG DELIVERED. BOTH MOUNTS SOUND.

quests.title: Ask the Bear

steps.objText: Ask Burl if bears eat crows
steps.journal: Rook wants to know if bears eat crows. Go and ask Burl.

quests.returnText: Tell Rook what the bear said

offer: I have a question for the bear. I won't ask it myself.
Ask her: do bears eat crows? Say it plain.
active: The question for the bear. Plain. Not mine.
ready: Only on feast days? Hm. Is today a feast day?
Never mind. A red draught. I stole it, fairly.
done: I will stay on the high branch. Thank you.

steps.objText: Give the brass scrap to Burl
steps.journal: Rook sends a brass scrap to Burl, as a peace gift. Give it to her.

offer: A scrap of brass. My second best. Take it to the bear.
Say it is from the crow. Say nothing else.
active: The brass. To the bear. Say nothing else.
ready: A crow gives me brass? Oh. Put it by my bed, sky-cub.
Tell him: not on feast days. Not ever. Here.
done: The brass shines by my bed. Tell the crow so.

quests.title: Gondola Plate

steps.objText: Find hide for a strap
steps.journal: A plate from the Kestrel's gondola would make a shield. Find hide for a strap.

quests.returnText: Bring the hide to the wrecked airship

offer: The side plate hangs by one rivet.
Bent round. Light. A strap would hold it.
active: A plate and a strap. Boar hide would do.
ready: Hide strap, brass plate. A buckler now.
Hold right mouse to block.
done: The wreck creaks. The plate is yours now.

steps.objText: Bring Burl's honeycomb to Rook
steps.journal: Burl sent honeycomb for the crow. Bring it to Rook.

offer: That crow on the old stone. Loud thing.
Take it this comb. Tell it we're square.
active: The comb is for the crow. Do not lick it.
ready: Sticky. From the bear? Hm. Square, then.
Sticks with feathers. Hunters lose them.
And this. On a branch. Fits a fell-bird.
done: Square with the crow. Good. I hate owing.

steps.objText: Find four brass scraps
steps.journal: Rook loves shiny things. Find four brass scraps and bring them back.

offer: Your sky-boat dropped shinies. Everywhere.
Four brass bits. Bring them. I trade fair.
active: Four brass bits. Your sky-boat sheds them.
ready: One, two, three, four. Good count.
Arrows, and red drink. Not shiny. Useful.
done: Shiny things. I keep them. You keep the arrows.

quests.title: The Oilcloth Packet

steps.objText: Leave the packet at the ford post
steps.journal: You found an oilcloth packet. Leave it at the ford post.

quests.returnText: Leave the packet at the ford post

offer: Oilcloth, tied with twine.
Stitched on the cloth: FOR THE FORD POST.
It has waited here a long time.
active: The packet. The ford post, by the crossroads.
ready: A basket on a post. Arrows inside, and a tag:
TAKEN. LEAVE WHAT YOU CAN SPARE.
Packet left. Arrows taken. Fair trade.
done: The basket waits. The tags turn in the wind.

steps.objText: Find three emberpods in Cinder Hollow
steps.journal: Burl promised to show you fire. Find three red emberpods in Cinder Hollow.

offer: Salt in my larder, sky-cub. Now a thing for you.
Down in Cinder Hollow, red pods grow in the ash.
Bring me three. Warm ones. I'll show you fire.
active: Three pods, sky-cub. Red, and warm to the paw.
Cinder Hollow. Follow the smell of old smoke.
ready: Warm still. Good. Now watch, and don't blink.
She cracks a pod between two claws. A coal glows.
She breathes on it. It leaps and bursts on a stump.
That's fire, sky-cub. Close your fist on it. Throw.
It's for teeth and tusks. Not for bushes. Not mine.
Take this, for when your fire runs low.
done: Feed your fire slow, sky-cub. It's always hungry.
